name: @excellent-so/selfdocs
description: The codebase that documents itself. One command scans your repo, drafts its architecture docs with the local `claude` CLI, and serves a viewer where your human annotations survive every regeneration.
author: Excellent
//dependencies: Zero runtime dependencies by design. The scan, the gitignore matcher, the markdown block parser/validator, and the viewer server are all hand-rolled on Node built-ins. Doc generation shells out to the `claude` CLI on your PATH; with no CLI (or `--mock`) a deterministic offline generator runs — so the whole tool works with no key and no network.
